mapper.sql: e.id, e.emp_no, e.name, e.gender, e.birth_date, CASE WHEN e.id_card IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(e.id_card, 4), '**********', RIGHT(e.id_card, 4)) END AS id_card_masked, e.phone, e.email, e.address, e.department, e.position, e.grade_code, g.grade_name, g.base_salary, COALESCE(s.allowance, 0) AS allowance, COALESCE(s.bonus_ratio, 0.2000) AS bonus_ratio, (SELECT p.score FROM performance_record p WHERE p.employee_id = e.id AND p.period = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') AND p.status = 'APPROVED' LIMIT 1) AS current_score, e.hire_date, e.status, e.resign_date, e.education, e.school, e.major, e.emergency_contact, e.emergency_phone

where.if: AND (e.emp_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT id, emp_no, name, gender, birth_date, id_card, phone, email, address, department, position, grade_code, hire_date, status, resign_date, education, school, major, emergency_contact, emergency_phone, created_at, updated_at FROM employee WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, emp_no, name, gender, birth_date, id_card, phone, email, address, department, position, grade_code, hire_date, status, resign_date, education, school, major, emergency_contact, emergency_phone, created_at, updated_at FROM employee WHERE emp_no = #{empNo}
SELECT FROM employee e JOIN salary_grade g ON g.grade_code = e.grade_code LEFT JOIN employee_salary s ON s.employee_id = e.id WHERE e.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM employee e JOIN salary_grade g ON g.grade_code = e.grade_code LEFT JOIN employee_salary s ON s.employee_id = e.id
ORDER BY e.emp_no LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee (emp_no, name, gender, birth_date, id_card, phone, email, address, department, position, grade_code, hire_date, status, education, school, major, emergency_contact, emergency_phone) VALUES (#{empNo}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{birthDate}, #{idCard}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{address}, #{department}, #{position}, #{gradeCode}, #{hireDate}, #{status}, #{education}, #{school}, #{major}, #{emergencyContact}, #{emergencyPhone})
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET grade_code = #{gradeCode} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_id, company, position, start_date, end_date, description, created_at FROM work_experience WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY start_date DESC
SELECT FROM employee e JOIN salary_grade g ON g.grade_code = e.grade_code LEFT JOIN employee_salary s ON s.employee_id = e.id WHERE e.id IN #{id} ORDER BY e.emp_no
SELECT DISTINCT department FROM employee WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY department
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE hire_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
SELECT department AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM employee WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY department ORDER BY value DESC
